What We Check

🔗

URL Shorteners

bit.ly, tinyurl, t.co — destination hidden, cannot inspect final URL.

🌍

Suspicious TLDs

.zip, .xyz, .top, .click — commonly abused for spam and scams.

⚡

Punycode / IDN

Internationalized domains that imitate legitimate brands.

🎯

Typosquatting

amaz0n, paypa1, app1e — typo-based brand impersonation.

🏗️

Subdomain Abuse

Deep chains and brands in subdomains of unrelated roots.

🔍

HTTP Tokens

@, //, long numeric sequences — suspicious URL patterns.

API for Agents

curl "https://www.marketnow.site/api/scam-check?domain=example.com"
